headline: Approved deputy registrar list for the November 3, 2026 State General Election and accepted voter checklist changes.
summary: Members accepted voter checklist additions, deletions, and changes from September 8, 2026 through October 23, 2026. They approved a list of deputy registrars for the November 3, 2026 State General Election. They also gave the City Clerk approval to send 30-day letters as necessary from November 4, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
decisions: Approved accepting the voter checklist additions, deletions, and changes from September 8, 2026 through October 23, 2026.

plain_text:
BOARD OF REGISTRARS 
October 23, 2026 at 4:45 PM 
 
The Clerk called the meeting to order. 
 
The Clerk called the roll. 
 
Present: Marc Gagnon, Matthew Normand, Marc Tremblay, Elizabeth Webster,  
Absent:  William Houghton 
 
 
 
1. Acceptance of the voter checklist additions, deletions, and changes from 
September 8, 2026 through October 23, 2026. 
On motion of M. Tremblay, duly seconded by M. Gagnon, it was voted to 
accept the voter checklist additions, deletions, and changes. 
    
 
2. Approval for the City Clerk to send 30-Day letters as deemed necessary from 
November 4, 2026 through February 28, 2027. 
On motion of M. Tremblay, duly seconded by M. Gagnon, it was voted to give 
approval for the clerk to send 30-day letters as necessary. 
    
 
3. Approval of the list of Deputy Registrars scheduled to work the November 3, 
2026 State General Election and for the City Clerk to appoint additional Deputy 
Registrars if necessary.  
On motion of E. Wester, duly seconded by M. Gagnon, it was voted to approve 
the list of deputy registrars to work the November 3, 2026 State General 
Election and to allow the City Clerk to appoint additional Deputy Registrars if 
necessary.  
    
 
There being no further business, on a motion of E. Wester duly seconded by  
M. Tremblay, it was voted to adjourn.   
  
 
 
 
A True Record.  Attest. 
 
 
      
                              Clerk 
 
Meeting Start Time: 4:49 p.m. 
Meeting End Time: 5:19 p.m.
